name: What is the typical timeline for an ADU design and build project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for an ADU design and build project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an ADU project can range from several months to over a year, depending on its complexity. The process typically involves initial consultation, design and architectural plan development (1-3 months), permitting and approvals (1-6 months, varies by jurisdiction), and construction (3-9 months). Unforeseen site conditions or design changes can extend these timelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: An ADU project typically takes 6 months to over a year, encompassing design, permitting, and construction phases.
